name: Flange
description: A pipe flange: the raised face, the bolt circle, and the bore they are all arranged around.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(30.9% 3.8%, 69.1% 3.8%, 96.2% 30.9%, 96.2% 69.1%, 69.1% 96.2%, 30.9% 96.2%, 3.8% 69.1%, 3.8% 30.9%); clip-path: polygon(30.9% 3.8%, 69.1% 3.8%, 96.2% 30.9%, 96.2% 69.1%, 69.1% 96.2%, 30.9% 96.2%, 3.8% 69.1%, 3.8% 30.9%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 58%, #000 58%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 58%, #000 58%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 30%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 44%, #000 44%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 44%, #000 44%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
